messages:
Carla R: Quick follow-up to the private/VPC RFC — we need a concrete migration plan for control-plane bisection + per-tenant ephemeral keys for private endpoints. Proposal in-thread so we can iterate.
Carla R: TL;DR: phase by region, start with non-prod tenants (10), issue short-lived certs (1h) via KMS/HSM, operator automates key exchange and renewal, fallback to regional shared endpoint if handshake fails.
Alice M: concerns: how do we preserve src IP for customers that rely on SNAT? Per-tenant peering changes could break source-based routing.
Brian W: agree w/ Alice. Tradeoff: per-tenant peering preserves srcip but increases peering count and route table churn. Shared regional endpoint is simpler but we must expose nat/preserve-src semantics.
Matt K: For Private (on-prem/VPC) customers we also need an operator path for offline cutovers. How do we rotate keys when there's no direct KMS connectivity (air-gapped)?
Carla R: good Q. Plan: support two flows — online (short-lived certs via Redwood KMS + service account renewal) and offline (customer imports signed CSR/one-time bootstrap token, operator rotates locally with a longer TTL fallback, e.g., 24h, until online rejoin)
Jen S: rollout checklist idea:
  1) build operator APIs: CreateTenantEphemeral(), RenewTenantCert(), RevokeTenantCert()
  2) simulate handshake with test harness + injected latency
  3) 10 non-prod tenants in us-west as canary
  4) expand per-region + night windows
  5) add automated rollback toggle at proxy layer
Brian W: Also need to address DNS TTL and client caching. If a tenant is cut over to a new controlplane surface and EP changes, low TTL (30s) recommended, but we must plan for clients that ignore TTLs.
Alice M: operational alerts to add:
  - high handshake failure rate (>1% over 5m)
  - cert renewal failures
  - increased latency on controlplane route by >50ms
sre-bot: new alert config created draft: /alerts/controlplane-handshake-failures.yaml (attached)
Carla R: example handshake seq (operator pseudocode):
```
# bootstrap (online)
POST /operator/tenants/123/bootstrap -> returns bootstrap-token
operator calls KMS-> sign ephemeral cert
push cert to tenant-agent
agent connects to tenant-endpoint using mTLS with ephemeral cert
```
Matt K: For air-gapped:
```
# offline flow
customer -> generate CSR locally
operator -> sign offline CSR with operator CA
customer -> load signed cert into agent
agent -> establish handshake
```
Jen S: testing spikes to run: certificate expiry race (simulate 2x renew TTL delay), peering route flaps when adding 100 tenants in a region (route update QPS), and fallback path stress (shared endpoint + routing rewrite).
Brian W: network-level cost estimate: per-tenant peering adds VPC attachment costs ~ $X/month per customer, also adds route table entries. We should gate per-tenant peering behind price+SLA tier.
Alice M: UX note: Console needs to show current auth surface for tenant (shared vs per-tenant), cert expiry time, and last handshake time. Also expose a "force-fallback" toggle for SRE.
Carla R: rollout safety mechanisms:
  - start in "observe-only" mode (no active cutovers, just simulate and collect metrics)
  - canary with 10 customers (non-prod) + synthetic traffic
  - automatic fallback circuit: if handshake error spikes, route to regional endpoint for 10m then retry
  - manual override from Console
Devops-bot: deployed operator v0.1 -> canary namespace created: private-onboard-canary
Matt K: question about backward compatibility: do agents need code changes? If yes, we require agent v2.1+ before tenant can cut over.
Carla R: yes, agent changes required: implement RenewFromOperator() and fail-open to legacy authentication for 2 weeks post-cutover for smooth rollback.
Jen S: action items assigned:
  - Brian: cost model and tier gating (owner)
  - Alice: UX mock for Console surfaces (owner)
  - Matt: offline operator flow + docs for customers (owner)
  - Carla: implement handshake and rollout orchestration (owner)
  - SRE: add alerts + dashboards (owner)
Brian W: I'll sketch cost table by EOD Tue.
Alice M: I'll drop a console mock by Wed. Adding a checkbox for "allow fallback to shared endpoint".
Carla R: ok — I'll PR operator API spec and spike for handshake automation. Target: internal beta in 3 weeks.
sre-bot: note: adding tracing for handshake path (trace id -> tenant_id) suggested
Carla R: good call. we'll add a tracing field and surface in Console traces view.
Devops-bot: canary deployed, test harness running (0.1r)
Jen S: if no objections by EOD tomorrow I'll convert checklist to RFC follow-up and kick off the PRs. :thumbsup!
Brian W: +1
Alice M: +1
Matt K: +1
Carla R: thanks all — will post follow-up PR link in this thread.
